Instructions

This is a fun scavenger hunt that you can do around town with teams. Features two different designs to fit your style. 

You’re free to alter the rules to your liking but these are some suggestions/tips:
1.	Making the teams: we found this worked well with teams of 4 or 5. If you are letting people drive, make sure the teams are small enough to fit in one car. You can assign teams or let people choose their own. 
2.	The list: Make at least two copies of the list for each team or send it to everyone virtually. 
3.	Setting a perimeter: depending on how long you have you can set a longer time and larger perimeter. We usually run this type of game in 90 minutes and you can go as far as you want as long as you make it back in time. You can set limits in your neighbourhood if it isn’t practical to have your teams drive.
4.	Judging: have someone designated to assign points before the start, preferably someone who is not participating (someone who doesn’t want to participate or is arriving late). 
5.	Points system: assign 2 points for every item that is achieved. There should be at least one team member in each video or picture. 
6.	Bonus points: this is up to your interpretation, you can assign 1 to 3 points to one team, multiple teams or no teams depending on how strong you think their submission is. My suggestion is to assign 1 point for most bonus categories and 2 or 3 for something really impressive. If you have a lot of teams, you can give 1st, 2nd and 3rd for each category. 

Overall, you can be flexible with the rules to what suits your group to maximize fun!
